elements.manual_reason: The caption remnant is fully gone by the end frame, so no candidate box covers it; box taken from its position in the first filmstrip frame.
elements.label: Ribbon caption remnant (finishing exit)

pattern.description: After the caption finishes wiping off, the Datadog log list scrolls upward inside the trace panel in discrete jumps, revealing later log lines (cart lookup, 'No cart found', 'Creating new cart') while the left sidebar stays fixed.
pattern.why_premium: The scroll walks the viewer down the trace's log story line by line, and it only starts once the caption is clear, so the text and the UI motion never compete.

build_hint.gsap: Sequence: finish caption clip-path wipe (power2.in), then tl.to('.log-list', {y: '-=290', duration: 0.7, ease: 'steps(6)'}) inside an overflow:hidden panel; for a smoother premium build use ease: 'power2.inOut' instead of steps.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(frame, [start, start+42], [0, -290], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic)}) on the list inside a fixed-height overflow-hidden container; caption mask completes before start.

notes: camera.move reports tilt_down, but the left timestamp sidebar stays fixed, so this reads as content scrolling inside the panel rather than a true camera tilt. The energy spikes come in discrete jumps (possibly a low-frame-rate screen recording or stepped scroll), so the scroll may not be continuous.
